blocked_claim: This is asymmetric local sender possession, not full DPoP, mTLS, token cnf binding, TLS exporter binding, nonce/replay-cache policy, a deployed gateway, or independent provenance.
focus: Replace service-owned symmetric caller HMAC secrets with asymmetric RS256 sender-possession verification pinned by a service-config public RSA JWK.
refactor: Removed selftest-only base64url encode wrapper from reporting_selftests.cpp and routed the helper through the production base64url codec for this path.
Centralized sender proof material construction around one length-prefixed tuple used by both service verification and package validator.
risk_addressed: Before rev0641 the service config contained a reusable caller secret; compromise or leakage of service-side config was enough to mint caller proofs. Rev0641 moves private signing material to the caller side and verifies only a public JWK at the service boundary before durable reservation.
substantive_changes: Service config now pins caller public RSA JWK kid/alg/n/e and rejects caller_binding_secret_id/caller_binding_hmac_sha256_secret.
Requests must include sender_possession.signature_b64url verified with RS256 over length-framed service/profile/request/principal/case material before any append.
Capability format advances to exact v36 and v35 downgrade fails closed.
